lines.say: Hours every week, stuck in traffic.
Your ideas keep coming. Your computer is back at home.
Claude's voice mode is great to talk to.
But it can't reach Claude Code, the agent that does the real work in your repositories.
C C voice gateway connects the two.
lines.caption: cc-voice-gateway connects the two.

lines.say: You talk to Claude in your car, or on your phone.
A Claude Code session on your own computer picks it up, and gets to work.
Ask why the build failed.
Have it fixed, with the tests run.
A worker creates a branch, commits, and opens a pull request.
When it's done, you hear the result in a sentence or two.
Nothing lands behind your back.
Every change is versioned with git, and arrives as a pull request.
Checked on GitHub, reviewed by Claude, and merged only when you say yes.
It's built for the road: voice only, short answers, nothing to read.
Approvals happen by voice.
And one phrase, emergency stop, locks everything at once.
Stuck in traffic?
Turn your commute into commits.
C C voice gateway. A prototype, open on GitHub, and provided as is.
lines.caption: cc-voice-gateway: a prototype, open on GitHub, provided as-is.
